WITH rental_totals AS (
  SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total
  FROM payment p
  JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
),
avg_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM rental_totals
)
SELECT rt.store_id,
       SUM(rt.total) AS combined_total,
       AVG(rt.total - a.avg_total) AS avg_excess
FROM rental_totals rt
CROSS JOIN avg_total a
WHERE rt.total > a.avg_total
GROUP BY rt.store_id
ORDER BY rt.store_id;
